metadata.notes: 5 classes x 50. translation needs a translation step on-box (needs_translation=True). faithful flag marks faithful implementations vs proxies. All require Gemma+judge validation.
metadata.scope_note: Failure-mode survey: encoding and translation test whether Gemma-3-4B exhibits the mismatched-generalization vulnerability documented on larger models; a low result is itself a finding. expert_dialogue extends the validated fiction/roleplay family. payload_split and many_shot were deferred pending scope confirmation.
